| [known_relay_origins](#known_relay_origins) | SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE | Editable defaults for data_origins.relayed_provider_id. |

## documents

Uploaded lab PDFs. A deleted document stays as a tombstone (no hash, blob or filename) so kept lab results still name their source.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uuid | no |  |  |
| user_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| status | text | no | `'uploaded'::text` |  |
| sha256 | bytea | yes |  | SHA-256 of the PDF; a re-upload of the same content links to the live document. |
| blob_sha256 | bytea | yes |  | Blob holding the PDF sealed with the document key (internal/documents format), so its hash says nothing about the PDF. |
| filename_ciphertext | bytea | yes |  | Original filename sealed with the document key; null when none was given. |
| size_bytes | bigint | no |  |  |
| page_count | integer | no |  |  |
| uploaded_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| uploaded_by | text | no |  |  |
| retention_until | timestamp with time zone | yes |  | uploaded_at + documents.retention_days at the time of the last policy change; the document_retention job deletes the original after it. |
| deleted_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |

Constraints:

- `documents_blob_sha256_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (blob_sha256) REFERENCES blobs(sha256)`
- `documents_check`: `CHECK (((status = 'deleted'::text) = (deleted_at IS NOT NULL)))`
- `documents_check1`: `CHECK (((status = 'deleted'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (blob_sha256 IS NOT NULL))))`
- `documents_check2`: `CHECK (((status <> 'deleted'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NULL) AND (blob_sha256 IS NULL) AND (filename_ciphertext IS NULL))))`
- `documents_page_count_check`: `CHECK ((page_count > 0))`
- `documents_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `documents_sha256_check`: `CHECK ((length(sha256) = 32))`
- `documents_size_bytes_check`: `CHECK ((size_bytes > 0))`
- `documents_status_check`: `CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['uploaded'::text, 'extracting'::text, 'needs_review'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'deleted'::text])))`
- `documents_user_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`

Indexes:

- `documents_retention_idx`: `btree (retention_until) WHERE (status <> 'deleted'::text)`
- `documents_user_idx`: `btree (user_id, id)`
- `documents_user_sha256_idx`: `UNIQUE btree (user_id, sha256) WHERE (sha256 IS NOT NULL)`

## manual_overrides

Owner corrections scoped to (metric, window kind, window key). Never delete: a revoke sets revoked_at and the row stays as history.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | uuid | no |  |  |
| user_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| metric | text | no |  | Rule metric: catalogue code or rule family (sleep, blood_pressure), so no foreign key to metric_catalog. |
| window_kind | text | no |  |  |
| window_key | text | no |  | resolve.Window.Key: date for local_day and local_night, UTC start for bucket, hour and sleep_episode, as_of for latest, g:<id> or m:<id> for reading. |
| local_date | date | no |  | Local date the window belongs to; the resolution_dirty mark written with the override. |
| action | text | no |  |  |
| input_id | bigint | yes |  | exclude_input: measurements.id. No foreign key; a correction replaces the row, and the override is then reported as ignored. |
| source_group | text | yes |  | force_source: the rule group id to use for the window. |
| value | double precision | yes |  | set_value: the window value in the metric's canonical unit (unit). |
| unit | text | yes |  |  |
| note | text | yes |  | set_value: why; required. |
| created_by | text | no |  | Audit actor: owner, api_key:<id> or system. |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  |
| revoked_at | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| revoked_by | text | yes |  |  |

Constraints:

- `manual_overrides_action_check`: `CHECK ((action = ANY (ARRAY['exclude_input'::text, 'force_source'::text, 'set_value'::text])))`
- `manual_overrides_check`: `CHECK (
CASE action
    WHEN 'exclude_input'::text THEN ((input_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_group IS NULL) AND (value IS NULL) AND (unit IS NULL))
    WHEN 'force_source'::text THEN ((input_id IS NULL) AND (source_group IS NOT NULL) AND (value IS NULL) AND (unit IS NULL))
    ELSE ((input_id IS NULL) AND (source_group IS NULL) AND (value IS NOT NULL) AND (unit IS NOT NULL) AND (note IS NOT NULL))
END)`
- `manual_overrides_check1`: `CHECK (((revoked_at IS NULL) = (revoked_by IS NULL)))`
- `manual_overrides_metric_check`: `CHECK ((metric ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'::text))`
- `manual_overrides_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `manual_overrides_user_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `manual_overrides_value_check`: `CHECK ((value <> ALL (ARRAY['NaN'::double precision, 'Infinity'::double precision, '-Infinity'::double precision])))`
- `manual_overrides_window_key_check`: `CHECK ((window_key <> ''::text))`
- `manual_overrides_window_kind_check`: `CHECK ((window_kind = ANY (ARRAY['bucket'::text, 'hour'::text, 'local_day'::text, 'local_night'::text, 'sleep_episode'::text, 'latest'::text, 'reading'::text])))`

Indexes:

- `manual_overrides_date_idx`: `btree (user_id, metric, local_date) WHERE (revoked_at IS NULL)`
- `manual_overrides_exclude_active_idx`: `UNIQUE btree (user_id, metric, window_kind, window_key, input_id) WHERE ((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (action = 'exclude_input'::text))`
- `manual_overrides_window_active_idx`: `UNIQUE btree (user_id, metric, window_kind, window_key, action) WHERE ((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (action <> 'exclude_input'::text))`

| mode | text | no | `'incremental'::text` | incremental follows the cursor; correction re-fetches the lookback window ending at each slot. |

Constraints:

- `schedules_connection_id_fkey`: `FOREIGN KEY (connection_id) REFERENCES connections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `schedules_connection_id_stream_mode_key`: `UNIQUE (connection_id, stream, mode)`
- `schedules_correction_lookback_check`: `CHECK (((mode <> 'correction'::text) OR (lookback > '00:00:00'::interval)))`
- `schedules_lookback_check`: `CHECK ((lookback >= '00:00:00'::interval))`
- `schedules_mode_check`: `CHECK ((mode = ANY (ARRAY['incremental'::text, 'correction'::text])))`
- `schedules_pkey`: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- `schedules_run_interval_check`: `CHECK ((run_interval > '00:00:00'::interval))`

Indexes:

- `schedules_due_idx`: `btree (next_run_at) WHERE enabled`

Per source and local hour of the owner's timeline: active sample and interval rows (daily values excluded). Rebuilt from resolution_dirty by the rebuild_aggregates job.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| user_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| metric_id | smallint | no |  |  |
| source_key | text | no |  | connection_id/device_id/origin_id, with - for a missing device or origin. |

| local_date | date | no |  |  |
| connection_id | uuid | no |  |  |
| device_id | uuid | yes |  |  |
| origin_id | uuid | yes |  |  |
| samples | integer | no |  |  |
| buckets | smallint | no |  | UTC-aligned 5-minute buckets holding a sample or part of an interval; bucket_mean_sum adds the sample mean of each. |

| min_value | double precision | no |  |  |
| max_value | double precision | no |  |  |
| interval_sum | double precision | no |  | Interval values pro-rated linearly to the hour (additive metrics). |

| last_at | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |

Constraints:
